title: Ways we work
intro: The enterprise can offer different service modalities, allowing for a flexible business model:

specialized-consulting.label: Specialized consulting
specialized-consulting.description: needs analysis and design of tailored solutions.

wellbeing-diagnostics.label: Well-being assessments
wellbeing-diagnostics.description: identification of individual, relational, group and organizational factors associated with well-being.

workshops.label: Workshops and learning experiences
workshops.description: in-person or online activities for different audiences.

training.label: Training
training.description: training for teachers, leaders, teams, professionals and community agents.

applied-research.label: Applied research
applied-research.description: studies on well-being, emotions, relationships and social dynamics.

social-project-design.label: Social project design
social-project-design.description: formulation of initiatives aimed at the well-being of specific communities and groups.

organizational-support.label: Organizational support
organizational-support.description: advice to develop well-being policies, programs and strategies.
